value.preferred_name: one name is selected as the preferred IUPAC name (PIN)

value.alternative_types: Other types are recommended where substitutive nomenclature was never recommended for a class or where another method simplifies a long cumbersome name.
value.chapter_P1: Several nomenclature types are discussed and all are used to generate preferred IUPAC names and names for general nomenclature.

value.chapter_P2: Most rules generate preferred names of cyclic and acyclic compounds directly.
value.derived_substituent_groups: Selection of preferred names is also needed for substituent groups derived from parent hydrides.
value.phane_nomenclature: Recommended when rings, ring systems, and chains are composed of entities that are themselves rings or ring systems, whether or not interconnected by chains.
value.ring_assemblies: Preferred-name selection for ring assemblies is treated in P-52.2.7.
value.saturation: The hydro/dehydro prefixes and ene/yne endings express the level of saturation.

value.characteristic_groups_as_prefixes: Selection is between retained names and systematic names as components of preferred IUPAC names.
value.substituted_parent_exception: Substituted parent structures are analyzed as preferred IUPAC names despite the otherwise unequivocal seniority orders in Chapter P-4.

value.algorithm: hierarchical rules based on seniority orders
value.result: one and only preferred parent name based on the senior parent structure
value.selection_concept: Selection of preferred IUPAC names in P-45
